Chapter 6772: Save Me, My Lord

Chapter 6772: Save Me, My Lord

Yudi simply had no idea who he was dealing with.

“Likeheaven Immortal Monarch wouldn’t dare to speak haughtily before me. I suppose death shall be the punishment for your arrogance.” Xiaoyue’s eyes turned sharp.

Yudi staggered backward, frightened.

“Make your move.” Xiaoyue said.

“Go, earth immortal!” He shouted and summoned a celestial beast resembling an illusory dwarf.

“This is a divine beast?” The crowd wondered.

Only a few had seen his beast before. Rumor told it was a divine-level beast. Despite its tiny frame, the beast’s aura surged outward and filled Beastmaster.

“It’s incredible.” Everyone sensed its power.

“Heavenly Wall!” He ordered the creation of the strongest defense.

“Bam!” Xiaoyue took one step backward and the beast became afraid.

It had created a wonderful domain earlier but now, it stared at her in horror. This was akin to a caterpillar spotting a gliding hawk.

“Pop!” The wall shattered as the beast ran and disappeared on the horizon.

“Return!” Yudi shouted for another summon to no avail.

Others couldn’t believe it - the mighty beast ran upon seeing the opponent. Yudi didn’t know what to do because there was an unshakable pact between them. The two had a long history, having survived crises before.

“Start.” Xiaoyue reached for him.

“Activate!” He channeled all of his power into the cauldron.

“Raa!” The cry of a divine beast echoed across Beastmaster.

The cauldron was made from the skull of a genuine divine beast. The bloodline and aura activated, forcing all cultivators and beasts into submission.

“This is the number one divine artifact!” Crowd members shouted.

As beastmasters, they had a keen awareness of bestial auras. This aura was purer than anything else.

“Ooo-” The aura erupted and shot toward Xiaoyue.

This was only a remnant of Qing Ji’s power, not the real thing. Xiaoyue purposely nullified the attack without destroying the cauldron.

“Crack!” Yudi suffered a devastating blow; his bones were shattered as he was smashed into the ground.

“She’s unbeatable.” Both Phoenix Emperor and Dragon Ancestor shared the same thought.

How could the gap be so immense? An immortal could obliterate Beastmaster with a single blow.

“Save me, My Lord!” Yudi felt death and chanted a mantra to ask for help, abandoning pride and honor.

“Boom!” The sky suddenly turned dark, replaced by another galaxy.

“Who dares hurt a member of my branch?!” A pair of eyes opened and a hallowed voice descended.

A starry pulse descended from above, aiming for Xiaoyue.

“Damn!” This pulse could destroy all of Azure Plain to the horror of the spectators.

“Scram!” Xiaoyue only needed one hand wave to dispel it. Next was a palm strike toward Yudi.

“Ahh!” The help was useless for she still obliterated him into nothingness.
